text:
isabel: hi all, starting today! quick q: where do i post setup issues (wifi, VPN), who-to-ask/process questions, and how do i mute onboarding-bot if it's too chatty? :wave:

zoe: welcome Isabel :tada: Device/login issues -> DM @it-support or post in #help if you want the group to see. Process/who-owns questions -> #new-hires for cross-team answers, #eng for eng-specific. For repo/cloud access follow #dev-access instructions and tag the owner.

it-support: For a tracked ticket use `/ticket create "VPN disconnect" --attach logs` or DM us with `vpn diag` output. Typical ETA 1-3 hours. If you want fewer bot pings, DM @onboarding-bot with `preferences notify minimal` or change Slack prefs > Mentions and reactions.

onboarding-bot: Hi Isabel! To opt out of reminders: DM me `unsubscribe` or `preferences quiet on`. You can also `@onboarding-bot remind me in 48h` for follow-ups.

nate: couple of etiquette notes: keep sensitive info out of public channels (redact tokens/screenshots), start a new thread for long deep-dive Qs so the channel doesn't get noisy, and use #introductions for a 1-line timezone/role/repo list so folks can add you to common resources.

isabel: awesome, thanks! posting intro now (UTC+1, infra eng). I'll DM @it-support the vpn logs and mute extra reminders. :thumbsup:
